rationale: The agent executed a return without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the policy. It also processed the refund to a gift card rather than attempting/refunding to the credit card as requested, without explaining why a credit card refund was not possible or seeking consent for the alternative. While the agent appeared to locate the user and orders, it did not clearly authenticate the user in the conversation and did not verify which of the two tablets was the more expensive before proceeding. The final information given (refund amount and destination) was stated after the write, not confirmed beforehand. These issues fail the pass bar.
